text_en: When Jesus saw the crowds, he went up the mountain; and after he sat down, his disciples came to him.
text_cn: 耶稣一见群众，就上了山，坐下；他的门徒上他跟前来，

text_en: Then he began to speak, and taught them, saying:
text_cn: 他遂开口教训他们说：

text_en: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
text_cn: “神贫的人是有福的，因为天国是他们的。

text_en: “Blessed are those who mourn, for they will be comforted.
text_cn: 哀恸(tòng)的人是有福的，因为他们要受安慰。

text_en: “Blessed are the meek, for they will inherit the earth.
text_cn: 温良的人是有福的，因为他们要承受土地。

text_en: “Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they will be filled.
text_cn: 饥渴慕义的人是有福的，因为他们要得饱饫（yù）。

text_en: “Blessed are the merciful, for they will receive mercy.
text_cn: 怜悯人的人是有福的，因为他们要受怜悯。

text_en: “Blessed are the pure in heart, for they will see God.
text_cn: 心里洁净的人是有福的，因为他们要看见天主。

text_en: “Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
text_cn: 缔造和平的人是有福的，因为他们要称为天主的子女。

text_en: “Blessed are those who are persecuted for righteousness’ sake, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
text_cn: 为义而受迫害的人是有福的，因为天国是他们的。

text_en: “Blessed are you when people revile you and persecute you and utter all kinds of evil against you falsely on my account.
text_cn: 几时人为了我而辱骂迫害你们，捏造一切坏话毁谤你们，你们是有福的。

text_en: Rejoice and be glad, for your reward is great in heaven, for in the same way they persecuted the prophets who were before you.
text_cn: 你们欢喜踊跃吧！因为你们在天上的赏报是丰厚的，因为在你们以前的先知，人也曾这样迫害过他们。”

text_en: “You are the salt of the earth; but if salt has lost its taste, how can its saltiness be restored? It is no longer good for anything, but is thrown out and trampled under foot.
text_cn: “你们是地上的盐，盐若失了味，可用什么使它再咸呢？它再毫无用途，只好抛在外边，任人践踏罢了。

text_en: “You are the light of the world. A city built on a hill cannot be hid.
text_cn: 你们是世界的光；建在山上的城，是不能隐藏的。

text_en: No one after lighting a lamp puts it under the bushel basket, but on the lampstand, and it gives light to all in the house.
text_cn: 人点灯，并不是放在斗底下，而是放在灯台上，照耀屋中所有的人。

text_en: In the same way, let your light shine before others, so that they may see your good works and give glory to your Father in heaven.
text_cn: 照样，你们的光也当在人前照耀，好使他们看见你们的善行，光荣你们在天之父。”

text_en: “Do not think that I have come to abolish the law or the prophets; I have come not to abolish but to fulfill.
text_cn: “你们不要以为我来是废除法律或先知， 我来不是为废除，而是为成全。

text_en: For truly I tell you, until heaven and earth pass away, not one letter, not one stroke of a letter, will pass from the law until all is accomplished.
text_cn: 我实在告诉你们：即使天地过去了，一撇或一画也决不会从法律上过去，必待一切完成。

text_en: Therefore, whoever breaks one of the least of these commandments, and teaches others to do the same, will be called least in the kingdom of heaven; but whoever does them and teaches them will be called great in the kingdom of heaven.
text_cn: 所以，谁若废除这些诫命中最小的一条，也这样教训人，在天国里，他将称为最小的；但谁若实行，也这样教训人，这人在天国里将称为大的。

text_en: For I tell you, unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven.
text_cn: 我告诉你们：除非你们的义德超过经师和法利塞人的义德，你们决进不了天国。

text_en: “You have heard that it was said to those of ancient times, ‘You shall not murder’; and ‘whoever murders shall be liable to judgment. ’
text_cn: 你们一向听过给古人说：“不可杀人！”谁若杀了人，应受裁判。

text_en: But I say to you that if you are angry with a brother or sister, you will be liable to judgment; and if you insult a brother or sister, you will be liable to the council; and if you say, ‘You fool, ’ you will be liable to the hell of fire.
text_cn: 我却对你们说：凡向自己弟兄发怒的，就要受裁判；谁若向自己的弟兄说“傻子”，就要受议会的裁判；谁若说“疯子”，就要受火狱的罚。

text_en: So when you are offering your gift at the altar, if you remember that your brother or sister has something against you,
text_cn: 所以，你若在祭坛前，要献你的礼物时，在那里想起你的弟兄有什么怨你的事，

text_en: leave your gift there before the altar and go; first be reconciled to your brother or sister, and then come and offer your gift.
text_cn: 就把你的礼物留在那里，留在祭坛前，先去与你的弟兄和好，然后再来献你的礼物。

text_en: Come to terms quickly with your accuser while you are on the way to court with him, or your accuser may hand you over to the judge, and the judge to the guard, and you will be thrown into prison.
text_cn: 当你和你的对头还在路上，赶快与他和解，免得对头把你交与判官，判官交给差役，把你投在狱里。

text_en: Truly I tell you, you will never get out until you have paid the last penny.
text_cn: 我实在告诉你：非到你还了最后的一文，决不能从那里出来。

text_en: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall not commit adultery. ’
text_cn: 你们一向听说过：“不可奸淫！”

text_en: But I say to you that everyone who looks at a woman with lust has already committed adultery with her in his heart.
text_cn: 我却对你们说：凡注视妇女，有意贪恋她的，他已在心里奸淫了她。

text_en: If your right eye causes you to sin, tear it out and throw it away; it is better for you to lose one of your members than for your whole body to be thrown into hell.
text_cn: 若是你的右眼使你跌倒，剜（wān）出它来，从你身上扔掉，因为丧失你一个肢体，比你全身投入地狱里，为你更好；

text_en: And if your right hand causes you to sin, cut it off and throw it away; it is better for you to lose one of your members than for your whole body to go into hell.
text_cn: 若你的右手使你跌倒，砍下它来，从你身上扔掉，因为丧失你一个肢体，比你全身投入地狱里，为你更好。

text_en: “It was also said, ‘Whoever divorces his wife, let him give her a certificate of divorce. ’
text_cn: 又说过：“谁若休妻，就该给她休书。”

text_en: But I say to you that anyone who divorces his wife, except on the ground of unchastity, causes her to commit adultery; and whoever marries a divorced woman commits adultery.
text_cn: 我却给你们说：除了姘居外，凡休自己的妻子的，便是叫她受奸污；并且谁若娶被休的妇人，就是犯奸淫。

text_en: “Again, you have heard that it was said to those of ancient times, ‘You shall not swear falsely, but carry out the vows you have made to the Lord. ’
text_cn: 你们又一向听过对古人说：“不可发虚誓！要向上主偿还你的誓愿！”

text_en: But I say to you, Do not swear at all, either by heaven, for it is the throne of God,
text_cn: 我却对你们说：你们总不可发誓：不可指天，因为天是天主的宝座；

text_en: or by the earth, for it is his footstool, or by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.
text_cn: 不可指地，因为地是他的脚凳；不可指耶路撒冷，因为她是大王的城市；

text_en: And do not swear by your head, for you cannot make one hair white or black.
text_cn: 也不可指你的头发誓，因为你不能使一根头发变白或变黑。

text_en: Let your word be ‘Yes, Yes’ or ‘No, No’; anything more than this comes from the evil one.
text_cn: 你们的话该当是：是就说是，非就说非；其他多余的，便是出于邪恶。

text_en: “You have heard that it was said, ‘An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth. ’
text_cn: 你们一向听说过：“以眼还眼，以牙还牙。”

text_en: But I say to you, Do not resist an evildoer. But if anyone strikes you on the right cheek, turn the other also;
text_cn: 我却对你们说：不要抵抗恶人；而且，若有人掌击你的右颊，你把另一面也转给他。

text_en: and if anyone wants to sue you and take your coat, give your cloak as well;
text_cn: 那愿与你争讼，拿你的内衣的，你连外衣也让给他。

text_en: and if anyone forces you to go one mile, go also the second mile.
text_cn: 若有人强迫你走一千步，你就同他走两千步。

text_en: Give to everyone who begs from you, and do not refuse anyone who wants to borrow from you.
text_cn: 求你的，就给他；愿向你借贷的，你不要拒绝。

text_en: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy. ’
text_cn: 你们一向听说过：“你应爱你的近人，恨你的仇人！”

text_en: But I say to you, Love your enemies and pray for those who persecute you,
text_cn: 我却对你们说：你们当爱你们的仇人，当为迫害你们的人祈祷，

text_en: so that you may be children of your Father in heaven; for he makes his sun rise on the evil and on the good, and sends rain on the righteous and on the unrighteous.
text_cn: 好使你们成为你们在天之父的子女，因为他使太阳上升，光照恶人，也光照善人；降雨给义人，也给不义的人。

text_en: For if you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Do not even the tax collectors do the same?
text_cn: 你们若只爱那爱你们的人，你们还有什么赏报呢？税吏不是也这样作吗？

text_en: And if you greet only your brothers and sisters, what more are you doing than others? Do not even the Gentiles do the same?
text_cn: 你们若只问候你们的弟兄，你们作了什么特别呢？外邦人不是也这样作吗？

text_en: Be perfect, therefore, as your heavenly Father is perfect.
text_cn: 所以你们应当是成全的，如同你们的天父是成全的一样。”
